title: Can I SURVIVE Fog of War?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Fog of War against (mostly) higher-rated humans aiming for three wins. You only see squares your own pieces can move to; there is no check warning, and the goal is to capture the king. He values fianchettoed bishops for vision, infers hidden moves from the last-move highlight, and wins three games by capturing the king.
rules: You can only see the squares your pieces can legally move to (plus your own pieces); everything else is fogged.
The game does not tell you if you are in check; kings can be captured.
Win by capturing the opponent's king.
The opponent's last-move highlight square is visible even in fog (from-square) (transcript 1:24).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 3 wins vs higher-rated humans.
